description: Trace letters, numbers, lines, or shapes following directional arrows.
name: Trace
pedagogicalObjective: Develop muscle memory for proper letter and number formation.

description: Write independent letters, words, sentences, or numbers into ruled lines.
name: Write
pedagogicalObjective: Transition from visual tracing to independent writing fluency.

description: Color themed illustrations, color-by-number, or color-by-letter activities.
name: Color
pedagogicalObjective: Reinforce concept recognition through visual art and motor control.

description: Circle correct answers, matching items, or target letters/numbers.
name: Circle
pedagogicalObjective: Identify and select correct items among distractors.

description: Find hidden objects, letters, numbers, or words in visual puzzles.
name: Find
pedagogicalObjective: Enhance scanning speed and visual pattern recognition.

description: Cut out paper elements along dotted lines and glue into target spots.
name: Cut and Paste
pedagogicalObjective: Strengthen hand-eye coordination and tactile sorting skills.

description: Draw lines connecting related pairs, words to pictures, or math equations to answers.
name: Match
pedagogicalObjective: Establish conceptual connections between symbols and meanings.

description: Draw missing parts, symmetrical halves, or geometric shapes.
name: Draw
pedagogicalObjective: Express visual understanding through geometric and artistic drawing.

description: Count visual objects and write or circle the correct numerical quantity.
name: Count
pedagogicalObjective: Build foundational number sense and visual counting confidence.

description: Compare quantities or numbers using greater than (>), less than (<), or equal (=).
name: Compare
pedagogicalObjective: Evaluate relative magnitude between numbers or sets.

description: Read short passages, decodable sentences, or vocabulary lists aloud.
name: Read
pedagogicalObjective: Build word recognition speed and reading comprehension.

description: Complete sentences or equations by supplying the missing word or number.
name: Fill in the Blank
pedagogicalObjective: Test vocabulary, grammar, and arithmetic recall in context.

description: Finish sentence stems using word bank prompts or original ideas.
name: Complete the Sentence
pedagogicalObjective: Develop sentence construction and expressive writing skills.

description: Label parts of a diagram (e.g. Plant Parts, Human Anatomy, Solar System).
name: Label
pedagogicalObjective: Identify physical components of natural and scientific systems.

description: Categorize words, numbers, or pictures into designated columns or groups.
name: Sort
pedagogicalObjective: Understand taxonomy and grouping rules across domains.

description: Examine scientific illustrations or charts and record observations.
name: Observe
pedagogicalObjective: Cultivate scientific inquiry through detailed visual analysis.

description: Arrange picture cards or story events in correct chronological order.
name: Sequence
pedagogicalObjective: Understand cause-and-effect and narrative sequence.

description: Identify, extend, or create AB, AABB, or numerical patterns.
name: Pattern
pedagogicalObjective: Recognize repeating sequences and predict subsequent elements.

description: Measure objects using paper rulers, paperclips, or standard units (cm/in).
name: Measure
pedagogicalObjective: Apply ruler measurement techniques to physical illustrations.

description: Collect data from tallies or pictures and create bar graphs or pictographs.
name: Graph
pedagogicalObjective: Translate raw numbers into visual data bar charts.

description: Solve crossword puzzles, word searches, or Sudoku grids.
name: Puzzle
pedagogicalObjective: Enhance cognitive stamina and spelling through word puzzles.

description: Solve logic riddles, matrix grids, or truth-table challenges.
name: Logic
pedagogicalObjective: Apply deductive logic to solve multi-variable problems.

description: Navigate printable path mazes from start to finish line.
name: Maze
pedagogicalObjective: Develop spatial navigation and continuous line control.

description: Connect numbered or alphabetized dots sequentially to reveal a hidden picture.
name: Dot to Dot
pedagogicalObjective: Reinforce number order 1-50 through picture reveal.

description: Color numbered regions according to the color legend code.
name: Color by Number
pedagogicalObjective: Reinforce number recognition while creating colorful artwork.

description: Color regions containing target uppercase/lowercase letters using a color key.
name: Color by Letter
pedagogicalObjective: Build letter discrimination through color-coded activity.

description: Identify the initial phoneme sound of pictures and write or circle the letter.
name: Beginning Sounds
pedagogicalObjective: Master beginning letter sound association.

description: Identify the final consonant sound of pictures and write the matching letter.
name: Ending Sounds
pedagogicalObjective: Isolate and identify ending consonant sounds in words.

description: Identify words or pictures that share the same rime ending sound.
name: Rhyming
pedagogicalObjective: Develop auditory discrimination for rhyming word pairs.

description: Supply missing vowels or consonants to complete target vocabulary words.
name: Missing Letters
pedagogicalObjective: Reinforce spelling rules and word construction.

description: Fill in blank boxes in skip counting or number sequence lines.
name: Missing Numbers
pedagogicalObjective: Identify numerical step values and fill sequence gaps.

description: Unscramble mixed word cards to assemble grammatically correct sentences.
name: Sentence Building
pedagogicalObjective: Construct complete sentences with proper punctuation.

description: Read a short story passage and answer text-dependent comprehension questions.
name: Reading Comprehension
pedagogicalObjective: Evaluate story details, characters, and main themes.

description: Write original short stories or descriptive paragraphs based on visual prompts.
name: Creative Writing
pedagogicalObjective: Encourage creative storytelling and independent writing.

description: Analyze scenarios, solve open-ended problems, and justify reasoning in writing.
name: Critical Thinking
pedagogicalObjective: Foster higher-order thinking skills and written justification.

description: Record hypotheses, experiment steps, observations, and conclusions.
name: Science Investigation
pedagogicalObjective: Guide learners through structured scientific experiments.

description: Study map keys, historical timelines, or community helper role sheets.
name: Social Studies
pedagogicalObjective: Understand community roles, geography, and world culture.

description: Complete design-build engineering challenges and sketch prototype models.
name: STEM
pedagogicalObjective: Apply STEM principles to prototype paper structures.

description: Construct 3D paper crafts, origami models, or seasonal paper decorations.
name: Craft
pedagogicalObjective: Transform 2D templates into 3D paper craft objects.

description: Perform safe, home/classroom hands-on science experiments with household items.
name: Experiment
pedagogicalObjective: Engage in active discovery learning through simple physics and chemistry.
